title: Lock out an air conditioner at its pull-out disconnect
instruction: Lock out the air conditioner AC-1 at its pull-out disconnect, the grey box with the yellow AC-1 label: lift its cover and hold it up, pull out the black pull-out block by its grip, turn it upside down and push it back in so that OFF shows, lower the cover shut, then put the red padlock through the hole in the tab at the bottom of the box and snap it shut. Do not touch the AC-2 disconnect (white label).
context: HVAC mechanics and installers (SOC 49-9021) and general maintenance and repair workers (49-9071) open the pull-out disconnect beside an outdoor air-conditioning unit at the start of nearly every service call: cleaning coils, replacing a capacitor or contactor, fixing a fan motor. They pull the block, reinsert it in its OFF position and padlock the cover so the unit cannot be re-energised while their hands are inside it. Pulling the wrong unit's disconnect, putting the block back ON, or leaving the cover unlocked defeats it.
setup: Positions are measured forward from the line joining the two arm bases (61 cm apart), left or right of their midline as seen from behind the robot, and up from the table top. Board: a plywood board (1.8 cm thick, 48 cm wide, 36 cm tall) stands on the table on two feet behind it, its front face 45 cm in front of the bases, spanning 33 cm right to 15 cm left of the midline. Disconnects: two Milbank U3802 60 A non-fused pull-out air-conditioner disconnects (grey painted steel; body 13.2 cm wide, 15.2 cm tall, 5.5 cm deep, about 7.8 cm deep with the cover) are screwed to the board with their bottoms 13 cm above the table: AC-1 centred on the midline and AC-2 centred 20 cm right of it. Each cover (0.3 kg, front plate reaching 1.5 cm below the box) is hinged at its top rear and hangs shut by its weight; opened, its top meets the board at about 94 degrees; its front is 37.2 cm in front of the bases and carries an engraved plate (8 x 4.4 cm, centred 23.6 cm above the table): AC-1 yellow, AC-2 white, black letters. Behind the cover a dead front has a 10 x 4.8 cm window holding the pull-out: a black plastic block (9.6 x 4.4 x 1.8 cm, 0.1 kg, centred 20.6 cm above the table) with a grip bar (6 x 1.4 cm, standing 1.6 cm out of its face); its four copper blades sit in the line and load clips, and the block is printed ON one way up and OFF the other. Turned over (half a turn about the direction it slides in), the blades go into insulated dummy pockets instead. A steel tab (2.2 cm wide, 2 mm thick) sticks forward out of each box's bottom through a slot (2.6 x 2.5 cm) near the bottom of the cover's front, ending 2 cm in front of the cover; it has an 8 mm hole centred 1.2 cm in front of the cover. Padlock: a red Master Lock 410RED Zenex safety padlock (body 38 x 44 x 19 mm, 6.35 mm steel shackle with 38 mm vertical clearance; 0.10 kg), open (shackle popped up 16 mm), stands upright on a grey column (3.0 x 0.9 cm, 11 cm tall, on a 6 x 5 x 1 cm foot) 18 cm in front of the bases and 21 cm left of the midline, its short leg toward the boxes. Both arms start at the ready pose with their grippers open. One fixed layout, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Score 0 if, at any time, AC-2's cover opens more than 5 degrees or its pull-out moves more than 4 mm or turns more than 8 degrees, or if AC-1's pull-out, once pulled, is pushed back in ON (its blades more than 3 mm into the live clips). Otherwise the score is set by the state at the end: 0.25 if AC-1's pull-out is out of its live clips; 0.5 if it is back in the box turned over (OFF reads upright), seated within 3 mm; 0.75 if, in addition, AC-1's cover is shut (within 4 degrees); 1.0 if, in addition, the padlock is shut (latched) through the tab's hole and the after-release check passes. After-release check, done once both grippers have been at least 6 cm from the padlock and the cover's bottom edge for 2 s: hook a spring scale under the cover's bottom edge and pull it outward and up, square to the cover, with 20 N for 2 s. Pass if the cover opens less than 10 degrees (its bottom edge moves out less than 3 cm), the shackle is still through the hole and the pull-out still OFF; if not, the score is 0.75.
reset_notes: Open the padlock with its key and take it off the tab; stand it back open on its column, short leg toward the boxes. Lift AC-1's cover, pull the pull-out, turn it ON side up and push it back into the live clips (it seats with a firm push), and let the cover fall shut. Check AC-2 is untouched (cover shut, pull-out ON). About 1 minute. For a real-world trial use an unwired disconnect (no conductors on its lugs).
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies on joints, arms with the station's i2rt gains. Lockout is geometry: a shackle in the tab's hole stops the cover's bottom swinging out; the blades grip in compliant-contact clips (starts sliding at 15 N here; real force unpublished, est. 20-50 N), loose in the OFF pockets. Inferred: window, block, clip, tab sizes. Simplified: box colliders, no hinge friction, shut stop is a joint limit, the 410 latches by a catch (no key). Details in README.
